question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"reflection."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Reflection"** is the bouncing back of light or sound waves from a surface. (किसी सतह से प्रकाश, ताप या ध्वनि की वापसी; परावर्तन) • In this context, the blank requires a word that describes the bouncing back of waves. • **Example**: *He put silver foil around the fire to increase heat **reflection**__.* • **Reflection** is the most appropriate word as it accurately describes the process of bouncing back of waves from a surface. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: Nainital has a __beautiful__ lake. Tourists come from far and wide to __enjoy__ boating here. There is a skating place behind it. People who skate here say that the ride seems to go round with them. Evenings are also pleasant here. The __**reflection**__ of the electric lights looks as if they are dancing in the ripples of the lake. Truly, Nainital is an ______ 4 ______ city of ______ 5 ______ beauty. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Shadow:** an area where direct light from a source is blocked by an opaque object. (परछाई (प्रकाश और सतह के बीच में किसी के आने से सतह पर बनी उसकी धुँधली आकृति), साया) • **Echo: **a sound that is repeated because it is reflected off a surface. (गूँज, प्रतिध्वनि) • **Mirror:** a surface that reflects light and forms an image. (दर्पण, शीशा) 45:Tcad, The correct answer is** "excellent."**
